lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct, high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section with slightly increased distance between the 4th and 5th segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped topological split is visible on the posterior-most stripe located on the upper haunch, where the line bifurcates into two narrow branches toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st and 2nd anterior lines are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso before reaching the ventral fringe; the 6th line is dashed and fragmented in the mid-section.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb, with a density of approximately 3 spots per 100 square pixels in the primary cluster zone.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two prominent spots on the mid-posterior thigh align horizontally, creating a semi-connected geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate curvature, rising at a posterior angle from the skull before twisting outward and then inward at the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately the terminal 12% of the overall vertical horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest of raised hair extends from the neck to the rump; high-contrast orange-tan pigmentation is visible on the lower limbs below the knee/elbow joints.
